notes.title: Become Public Enemy #1 – Heistfest Demo Out Sept 16
notes.notes: [p]Rob banks.  Outrun the cops.  Survive tanks, choppers, and airstrikes.[/p][p]You are Public Enemy #1, a notorious getaway driver on a global crime spree. From the streets of Italy to the pyramids of Egypt, every run is a fresh challenge across destructible, hand-drawn cityscapes.[/p][p] What to expect in the demo:[/p][p]Outdrive escalating police forces across wide-open maps[/p][p]Unlock legendary vehicles & test wild power-ups[/p][p]Experience the striking black-and-white visual style[/p][p]Pure replayable intensity — no story, no rules, just chaos[/p][p] Wishlist Heistfest on Steam : [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451220/Heistfest/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]and [b]play the demo starting September 16 @ 9 AM PT![/b][/p][p]Thank you for all the support — we can’t wait to see your craziest escapes. notes.title: 🚀 Amilcar Technologies Partners with indie.io! 🚀
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to share some exciting news – [b]Amilcar Technologies[/b] has officially partnered with [b]indie.io[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]This partnership marks a huge milestone in our journey to bring you the best possible experience in [i]Heistfest[/i]. With indie.io’s support, we’ll be able to push our vision further, deliver more content, and keep improving the game for you[/p][p]To kick things off, our [b]Steam Store Page has been refreshed[/b] with new visuals and updates. Take a look, let us know what you think, and don’t forget to share your feedback – your voice helps shape the future of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey. This is just the beginning, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon![/p][p][/p]
